title: BETWEEN or AMONG?
summary: Between picks out separate individuals; among places something inside a group.
objectives: Choose between or among by picturing the relationship.

steps.title: Between two things
steps.alt: A ball between two trees, with the sentence: The ball is between the trees.

say.text: Here are two trees, drawn as separate things.
The ball sits in the space that the two trees mark out. We say _The ball is between the trees._
**Between** relates something to individual, separate points.

actions.text: The ball is between the trees, which is a really long sentence that would run off the board

steps.title: Among a group
steps.alt: A ball inside a crowd of dots, with the sentence: The ball is among the leaves.

say.text: Now a crowd of leaves. The ball is somewhere inside the group: _among the leaves_.

check.prompt: The prize was shared ___ the three winners.

options.why: The three winners are treated as one group.
Between is also used here by many writers when each winner is thought of separately, but among is the safer exam answer.
options.mistakeExplain: Among: inside a group. Between: related to separate individuals.
